 Sulwhasoo Launches at Harrods, Steps Up Push into European Market
 by Kwon Jaehee 
 Published 27 Oct.2026 09:56(KST) 
 Share 
 Language 
 Text Size 
 Print 
 Enters Harrods, the UK's leading department store founded in 1849
Targets Europe with ginseng science and Korean heritage
World-first preview launch of the "Jinsul Myeongjak Line" set for December
Holistic spa services also offered
 Sulwhasoo, Amorepacific's luxury beauty brand, is strengthening its push into the European market with its official launch at Harrods, the UK's leading luxury department store. The strategy is to expand its engagement with global luxury customers by highlighting its Korean heritage and ginseng research, while offering a distinctive brand experience in the local market.
 View of the Sulwhasoo store inside Harrods in London, UK. Photo provided by Amorepacific.
 View original image 
 Sulwhasoo said on October 27 that it opened an official store at Harrods in London on October 23. Founded in 1849, Harrods is one of the UK's leading department stores and has showcased world-renowned luxury brands throughout its long history. Through this launch, Sulwhasoo plans to introduce its brand identity and key products to European luxury consumers.
 The store sells key skincare products, including its signature First Care Activating Serum and Concentrated Ginseng Renewing Cream. Sulwhasoo plans to highlight the competitiveness of its products through more than 60 years of accumulated ginseng research and its "Skin Longevity" philosophy, which emphasizes the long-term management of skin aging.
 Products available exclusively at Harrods are also on offer. Sulwhasoo's top-tier prestige skincare range, "The Ultimate S Collection," is sold exclusively at Harrods in the UK. In December 2026, the "Jinsul Myeongjak Line" is scheduled to make its global debut as a Harrods preview. The strategy is to target luxury department store customers not only with signature products but also with its top-tier range and new products.
 Sulwhasoo is differentiating the service experience as well as its products. The brand offers its signature beauty ritual, the "Holistic Touch" spa program. Through facial and hand treatments rooted in Korean beauty philosophy, customers can experience the balanced beauty that Sulwhasoo pursues.
 Exterior of Harrods in London, UK, where Amorepacific's Sulwhasoo has opened a store. Courtesy of Amorepacific.
 View original image 
 The store's design draws inspiration from Sulwhasoo's Bukchon flagship store in Korea. It reinterprets Korean aesthetics in a contemporary way, creating a space where tradition and modernity harmonize. The store is designed to let customers experience everything from signature skincare products to the top-tier prestige range in one place.

 With its launch at Harrods, Sulwhasoo plans to introduce its brand identity, rooted in Korean heritage and ginseng science, to the European luxury market. By combining product sales with exclusive products, advance launches of new products, and spa programs, the brand plans to broaden its engagement with local customers and strengthen its position in the global luxury beauty market.
